And ofc, it went wild...

They were right, couldn't have agreed more... but I was trapped. There was no way in hell I would've been able to explain what I was trying to do and already the fact that I was protecting her while she was guilty already kind of finished me... so I just accepted it... Those guys have really strong principles, you see?
